body.label: Target
body.html: One visible space within 2 units; yourself or a willing ally adjacent to it.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Mark the space until the start of your next turn. While adjacent to it, the target gains +1 Fortitude and resists its next 1 unit of forced movement.

surges.html: Choose a second willing creature adjacent to the point.
Suppress one Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties on a protected target until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Standard
rider.html: Spend this Authority when a protected creature remains beside the point after taking Damage: it becomes Rallied until your next turn; the Damage and Wounds still apply.
